archetypes.name: bug-flow
archetypes.rationale: /bug is a new stateful parent around /issue with success and failure branches.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the new /bug skill as an executable prompt. Focus on empty input, prose that begins with --, issue body structure, /issue invocation arguments, stdout parsing, sentinel verification, cleanup, and success versus failure reporting. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: tmp-hook
archetypes.rationale: The skill relies on a Write hook and /tmp-only scratch paths.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review whether the new skill's write posture matches the deny-edit-write hook. Check that prompt-side Write paths remain under canonical /tmp, that repo edits are forbidden, and that Bash examples do not create a bypass that weakens the advertised contract. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
